global_decision_policy.compliant: All applicable mandatory subchecks pass and every required section or page has complete active-version coverage.
global_decision_policy.defect_found: Complete active-version evidence proves that at least one applicable mandatory requirement is absent, inconsistent, or unsatisfied.
global_decision_policy.not_applicable: Structured matter facts conclusively show that the conditional requirement does not apply to this Civil SLP.
global_decision_policy.not_determined: Required evidence, processing, page coverage, or provider output is missing, failed, skipped, or incomplete.
global_decision_policy.needs_review: Evidence conflicts, legal interpretation is ambiguous, physical evidence is required, or a lawyer must make the final assessment.

authority_crosswalk.reason: Court-fee evidence is evaluated by D002.
Petition and application signatures are evaluated by D003.
All five cause-title, address, substitution and contact subparts are mapped to D004.
Supporting affidavit, attestation and identification are evaluated by D005.
Translation or exemption evidence is required only when vernacular content exists.
The prior-petition statement is evaluated with Form 28 declarations.
Vakalatnama, power-of-attorney and incorporated-body authority subparts are mapped to D006.
Permission to appear in person applies only when the petitioner is not represented by an AOR.
Surrender and custody-proof requirements belong to criminal matters and require a future criminal catalogue.
The no-private-motive affidavit applies only where the filing is classified as PIL.
Listing Proforma completeness is evaluated by D008.
Legibility and document-quality requirements are evaluated by D010.
A time-barred petition requires both delay details and fee-bearing condonation material.
English provisions are required when non-English provisions are relied upon.
Identical Supreme Court matter particulars are evaluated with petition declarations.
The Order XIX Rule 3(1) statement is evaluated by D001.
The NCDRC deposit applies only to qualifying consumer appeals.
Form 28 structure and certificate are evaluated by D001.
Order XV Rule 1 compliance is evaluated by D001.
Paper arrangement is evaluated by D008.
List of Dates presence and placement are evaluated by D008.
Consecutive numbering and Index alignment are evaluated by D008.
A PDF cannot prove the physical number of paper-book copies submitted.
Impugned-decision particulars and supporting document consistency are jointly evaluated.
Judgment, decree and certificate are required only for an appeal by certificate.
Annexure true-copy and chronological-order checks are evaluated by D010.
Separate annexure filing and indexing are evaluated by D010.
Trial and First Appellate Court orders apply to an SLP against a Second Appeal order.
The signed, complete Listing Proforma is evaluated by signature and sequence checks.
PIL identity, interest and no-private-motive disclosures apply only when the matter is PIL.
AFT leave certificate applies only to an appeal under the Armed Forces Tribunal Act.
Final physical paper-book order must be confirmed after all defects are cured.

defects.title: Form 28 structure and declarations
defects.objective: Confirm that the Civil SLP follows the official Form 28 petition body and contains the declarations and statements required by the current filing checklist.
defects.instruction: Read the exact Main Petition range, its headings and the active document outline. Check the court and jurisdiction caption, Article 136/Special Leave Petition description, party positions, opening statement identifying the challenged court, case, date and result, Questions of Law, Rule 4(2) declaration, Rule 6 true-copy declaration, Grounds, Grounds for Interim Relief, Main Prayer, Interim Relief, place, date, advocate and settled-by fields. Also check the current checklist statements about an earlier petition, identical Supreme Court matters and Order XIX Rule 3(1). Do not treat a mere mention in an Index as the required statement.

subchecks.title: Form 28 caption and parties
subchecks.criterion: The petition identifies the Supreme Court, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction, Article 136/Special Leave Petition and party positions.
manual_review_when: OCR or section boundaries are incomplete

subchecks.title: Impugned decision opening
subchecks.criterion: The opening statement identifies the challenged court or tribunal, case number, decision date and nature of the order.
manual_review_when: The petition challenges more than one decision

subchecks.title: Questions of Law
subchecks.criterion: A distinct Questions of Law section contains one or more questions for consideration.
manual_review_when: Heading is present but section content is not retrievable

subchecks.title: Rule 4(2) prior-petition declaration
subchecks.criterion: The petition states whether another leave petition was filed against the impugned decision and gives its result when applicable.
manual_review_when: Prior filing facts conflict

subchecks.title: Rule 6 true-copy declaration
subchecks.criterion: The petition declares that annexures are true copies of material forming part of the record below.
manual_review_when: Declaration wording is qualified or conflicting

subchecks.title: Grounds, reliefs and no separate interim relief application
subchecks.criterion: Grounds, Grounds for Interim Relief, Main Prayer and Interim Relief sections are present and incorporated within Form 28 as applicable. No separate application for interim relief shall be filed outside Form 28; if interim relief is sought, it must be incorporated within the petition itself.
manual_review_when: Whether interim relief is sought cannot be determined
A separate application for interim relief may exist after the annexures

subchecks.title: Other mandatory declarations
subchecks.criterion: Identical Supreme Court matter particulars and the Order XIX Rule 3(1) statement are supplied where required.
manual_review_when: Applicability or wording requires AOR interpretation

decision_policy.compliant: All applicable Form 28 and declaration subchecks pass with complete Main Petition coverage.
decision_policy.defect_found: A mandatory Form 28 component or declaration is absent under complete coverage.
decision_policy.not_applicable: A conditional relief or declaration is conclusively inapplicable.
decision_policy.not_determined: The Main Petition range or a required declaration could not be completely retrieved.
decision_policy.needs_review: The wording exists but its legal sufficiency or applicability is ambiguous.

defects.title: Court fee or exemption
defects.objective: Determine whether visible and structured evidence supports the prescribed court fee or an applicable fee-bearing exemption, delay application or statutory deposit.
defects.instruction: Inspect the document outline, Index, court-fee pages, visual evidence, applications and structured filing facts. Confirm that a court-fee item is present. When translation exemption or condonation of delay is relied upon, check that the associated application, affidavit and fee evidence are present. When the source proceeding is an applicable NCDRC consumer matter, look for the prescribed deposit evidence. Do not infer the monetary sufficiency of a physical or electronic fee solely from a visual stamp; ambiguous values require lawyer review.

subchecks.title: Base court fee
subchecks.criterion: The filing contains identifiable court-fee evidence or a supported exemption basis.
manual_review_when: Fee amount or denomination cannot be read reliably

subchecks.title: Translation-exemption fee
subchecks.criterion: An application seeking exemption from official translation includes related affidavit and court-fee evidence.
manual_review_when: Language detection is uncertain

subchecks.title: Delay-application fee
subchecks.criterion: A time-barred filing contains a condonation application with affidavit and court-fee evidence.
manual_review_when: Limitation calculation is unresolved

subchecks.title: NCDRC deposit
subchecks.criterion: Where the consumer appeal requires it, evidence of the statutory deposit is present.
manual_review_when: Applicable Act, ordered amount or deposit value requires legal/financial confirmation

decision_policy.compliant: All applicable fee and deposit subchecks have complete supporting evidence.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete inventory proves required fee or application evidence is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: The conditional exemption, delay or NCDRC requirement does not apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: Court-fee pages or applicable-condition facts are incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: A visible fee exists but amount, validity or statutory sufficiency needs lawyer confirmation.

defects.title: Petition and application signatures
defects.objective: Check the detected signature slots in the petition, applications and listing material without claiming signer identity or authenticity.
defects.instruction: Use structured visual formalities and signature-slot records before text similarity. Identify all petition, application, AOR, party-in-person, deponent and Listing Proforma signature labels. For each detected slot, determine present, absent or not determined using exact page evidence. Do not identify the person from handwriting and do not treat a typed name as a handwritten signature. A negative result requires complete visual analysis of every relevant page.

subchecks.title: Petition execution
subchecks.criterion: The original petition set contains a signature-like mark at the AOR or party-in-person execution slot.
manual_review_when: Visual coverage is partial or signature role is unknown

subchecks.title: Application execution
subchecks.criterion: Every detected application requiring execution contains a signature-like mark at its applicable signature slot.
manual_review_when: The required signer for an application is ambiguous

subchecks.title: Listing Proforma execution
subchecks.criterion: The complete Listing Proforma contains the required AOR signature-like mark.
manual_review_when: Listing Proforma is not machine-locatable

decision_policy.compliant: Every applicable detected signature slot is present with complete visual coverage.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete visual coverage shows an applicable signature slot is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: No applications or conditional signature locations apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: Any relevant page failed or a signature slot could not be localized.
decision_policy.needs_review: A mark is visible but its role or relationship to the slot is ambiguous.

defects.title: Cause title and Memo of Parties
defects.objective: Verify party names, positions, representation, service details and consistency across the petition and impugned decision.
defects.instruction: Retrieve exact cause-title, Memo of Parties, impugned-decision and Vakalatnama sections plus structured party entities. Compare normalized party names and positions without silently resolving conflicts. Check complete addresses, representation, appropriate Union/State department and service address, email/mobile fields, and conditional legal-representative/substitution details. PIL and incorporated-body details remain conditional. Report conflicting values as needs_review with both sources.

subchecks.title: Party-name and position consistency
subchecks.criterion: Party names and positions in the petition correspond with the impugned judgment and Memo of Parties, subject to explained transposition.
manual_review_when: Names differ after normalization or parties were added, deleted or transposed

subchecks.title: Addresses and representation
subchecks.criterion: Each party has a complete address and representation description sufficient for the filing record.
manual_review_when: Address completeness depends on local service requirements

subchecks.title: Government service details
subchecks.criterion: Where Union or State Government is a party, the proper department and service address are specified.
manual_review_when: Correct department requires legal confirmation

subchecks.title: Legal representatives and substitution
subchecks.criterion: For a deceased party below, LR, substitution, delay/abatement applications, relationship, age, address, affidavit and fee evidence are present as applicable.
manual_review_when: Abatement or limitation consequences require AOR review

subchecks.title: Party contact details
subchecks.criterion: Mobile numbers and email addresses are stated in the cause title and Vakalatnama where required.
manual_review_when: Redaction or privacy masking is present

subchecks.title: PIL disclosures
subchecks.criterion: A PIL supplies identity, address, contact, income/occupation, personal-interest, connected-litigation and public-injury disclosures.
manual_review_when: PIL classification or disclosure adequacy is disputed

decision_policy.compliant: All applicable party and service-detail subchecks pass with complete relevant-section coverage.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete evidence proves mandatory party, address, contact or conditional bundle information is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: A conditional government, LR or PIL requirement conclusively does not apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: A required cause-title or party section is unavailable.
decision_policy.needs_review: Normalized party facts conflict or legal representation cannot be resolved mechanically.

defects.title: Affidavit, verification and attestation
defects.objective: Check that supporting affidavits contain verification, deponent execution, identification and visible attestation indicators without claiming legal authenticity.
defects.instruction: Resolve every affidavit scope and its verification pages. Use PostgreSQL formalities and signature slots before general visual search. Check deponent or authorized-person identification, verification wording, deponent signature-like mark and visible attestation or notarial indicators. For PIL, check the no-private-gain/private-motive affidavit statement. Do not say genuine, validly notarized, or identify a signer. A negative visual conclusion requires complete analysis of all relevant pages.

subchecks.title: Supporting affidavit in support of statement of facts
subchecks.criterion: A supporting affidavit in support of the statement of facts contained in the petition is present, filed after the SLP following the AOR's Certificate, with a complete attestation.
manual_review_when: Document boundaries are incomplete

subchecks.title: Verification and deponent execution
subchecks.criterion: Each affidavit has verification text and a signature-like mark associated with the Deponent slot.
manual_review_when: Signature role or scope association is ambiguous

subchecks.title: Visible attestation and identification
subchecks.criterion: Each applicable affidavit contains visible indicators of attestation and identification consistent with the filing material.
manual_review_when: Visible indicators exist but authenticity and legal validity are not assessed

subchecks.title: PIL motive affidavit
subchecks.criterion: Where the filing is a PIL, the affidavit states there is no personal gain, private motive or oblique reason.
manual_review_when: Equivalent wording requires AOR interpretation

decision_policy.compliant: Every applicable affidavit has complete textual and visual evidence satisfying all mandatory subchecks.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete evidence proves a required affidavit, verification or deponent signature slot is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: A conditional PIL affidavit requirement does not apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: Any affidavit page or formality assessment is incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: Visible attestation exists but its sufficiency requires lawyer confirmation.

defects.title: Vakalatnama and representation authority
defects.objective: Verify the filing contains the applicable Vakalatnama, appearance, power-of-attorney and organizational authority records.
defects.instruction: Retrieve the Vakalatnama, Memo of Appearance, party profile and related authority documents. Confirm execution by petitioner, acceptance by AOR and presence of Memo of Appearance. If a power-of-attorney holder acts, check the English or translated power and permission material. If an incorporated body files, check registration and authority evidence. If party-in-person, check the permission application. Use visual signature records only for visible presence and never for identity or authenticity.

subchecks.title: Vakalatnama and Memo of Appearance
subchecks.criterion: A Vakalatnama is executed by the petitioner, accepted by the AOR, and accompanied by Memo of Appearance.
manual_review_when: AOR acceptance mark is ambiguous

subchecks.title: Power-of-attorney representation
subchecks.criterion: A filing through power of attorney contains the English/translated power and applicable permission material.
manual_review_when: Scope of authority requires legal interpretation

subchecks.title: Incorporated-body authority
subchecks.criterion: A registered body supplies registration evidence and proof that the filing person is authorized.
manual_review_when: Authority language or corporate status is ambiguous

subchecks.title: Party-in-person permission
subchecks.criterion: A party-in-person supplies the permission application and required explanation regarding representation.
manual_review_when: Application adequacy requires Registry/AOR assessment

decision_policy.compliant: The complete applicable representation bundle is present.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete evidence proves a mandatory representation document or execution slot is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: The power-of-attorney, incorporated-body or party-in-person condition is false.
decision_policy.not_determined: Representation type or required document coverage is incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: Authority wording or execution sufficiency needs lawyer confirmation.

defects.title: Limitation and impugned-order dates
defects.objective: Check impugned-decision particulars and determine whether delay and condonation information is complete and internally consistent.
defects.instruction: Retrieve the petition opening, List of Dates, impugned decision, certified-copy information and any delay application. Compare court, case number, decision date and result across exact sources. Use deterministic date normalization and preserve conflicts. When structured limitation facts show delay, check the stated number of days, condonation application, affidavit and fee evidence. Do not calculate a legally final limitation period from uncertain dates or exceptions; mark such cases needs_review.

subchecks.title: Impugned-decision consistency
subchecks.criterion: Court, case number, decision date and nature of the impugned order are uniformly stated across the petition and supporting documents.
manual_review_when: More than one order is challenged or normalized facts conflict

subchecks.title: Delay days stated
subchecks.criterion: Where the filing is time barred, the condonation application states the number of delayed days.
manual_review_when: Final limitation calculation depends on exclusions or condonable periods

subchecks.title: Condonation bundle
subchecks.criterion: A time-barred filing includes the condonation application, supporting affidavit and court-fee evidence.
manual_review_when: A document's role cannot be determined

decision_policy.compliant: Impugned-decision facts are consistent and every applicable delay requirement passes.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete evidence proves a required delay statement or condonation document is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: Structured facts conclusively show that delay requirements do not apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: Required decision dates or limitation facts are unavailable.
decision_policy.needs_review: Dates conflict or legal limitation requires AOR calculation.

defects.title: Filing sequence, index and pagination
defects.objective: Check document order, List of Dates, Index alignment, consecutive numbering and Listing Proforma completeness.
defects.instruction: Use the active document outline, page inventory, typography, Index rows and document-content map. Confirm the expected filing sequence, Brief List of Dates, consecutive paragraph/page numbering and accurate Index page ranges. Confirm the Listing Proforma is present, complete and signed through D003 evidence. Record physical paper-book count and final post-curing order as manual requirements because an uploaded PDF cannot prove them. Do not renumber or modify the original.

subchecks.title: Paper arrangement
subchecks.criterion: The filing components are arranged in the applicable Order XXI sequence.
manual_review_when: A component has an unknown role

subchecks.title: Brief List of Dates
subchecks.criterion: A Brief List of Dates or equivalent chronology component is present.
manual_review_when: Chronology is merged into Synopsis and boundaries are unclear

subchecks.title: Index and numbering consistency
subchecks.criterion: Paragraphs and pages are consecutive and the Index accurately records component page ranges.
manual_review_when: Printed pagination is missing or OCR confidence is low

subchecks.title: Listing Proforma
subchecks.criterion: The Listing Proforma is present, Columns 6 (connected/pending matters) and 7 (similar matters) of the Proforma for First Listing are duly filled in, all other relevant columns are complete, and signature evidence is available.
manual_review_when: A required column's applicability is unclear

subchecks.title: Physical paper-book requirements
subchecks.criterion: Required physical paper-book copies and final order after curing defects are confirmed by a filing operator.
manual_review_when: Always requires physical filing confirmation

decision_policy.compliant: All machine-checkable sequence and indexing checks pass and manual confirmations are supplied where applicable.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete page and Index evidence proves a sequence, pagination or mandatory component defect.
decision_policy.not_applicable: A conditional sequence component conclusively does not apply.
decision_policy.not_determined: Page, Index or printed-number coverage is incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: Physical paper-book requirements or ambiguous component roles require human confirmation.

defects.title: Impugned decisions and translations
defects.objective: Confirm the required decisions, certificates, prior-court orders, translations and cited provisions are present for the applicable case path.
defects.instruction: Retrieve the document outline, impugned decision, lower-court orders, certificate material and translation-related applications. Confirm the decision challenged by the petition is present and its particulars match D007. If the matter is an appeal by certificate, check judgment, decree and certificate. If the challenged order is in Second Appeal, check Trial Court and First Appellate Court orders. Detect vernacular content and require official translation or the application/affidavit/fee exemption bundle. Check English versions of relied-upon provisions where applicable. Apply the AFT certificate rule only to an AFT appeal.

subchecks.title: Impugned decision present
subchecks.criterion: The challenged judgment or order is present and identifiable in the active filing.
manual_review_when: Multiple decisions are challenged

subchecks.title: Appeal-by-certificate documents
subchecks.criterion: An appeal by certificate includes the judgment, decree and order granting certificate.
manual_review_when: Filing path is uncertain

subchecks.title: Second Appeal prior orders
subchecks.criterion: An SLP against a Second Appeal order includes Trial Court and First Appellate Court orders.
manual_review_when: Court-level classification is ambiguous

subchecks.title: Official translation or exemption application
subchecks.criterion: Every vernacular document in the annexures has an official translation filed. If the translation filed is not an official one, an application seeking exemption from filing the official translation is present in the applications placed after the annexures, along with its supporting affidavit and the court fee.
manual_review_when: Language or translation status is uncertain

subchecks.title: English provisions appendix
subchecks.criterion: Relevant non-English constitutional, statutory or regulatory provisions relied upon are supplied in English.
manual_review_when: Whether a provision is relevant requires legal interpretation

subchecks.title: AFT leave certificate
subchecks.criterion: An appeal under the Armed Forces Tribunal Act includes evidence of moving the AFT for leave to appeal.
manual_review_when: Nature of AFT certificate is unclear

decision_policy.compliant: The impugned decision and every conditionally required order, certificate or translation are present.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete case-path evidence proves a mandatory document or translation bundle is absent.
decision_policy.not_applicable: The certificate, Second Appeal, translation, provision or AFT condition is false.
decision_policy.not_determined: Case path, language or document coverage is incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: Document classification or legal relevance is ambiguous.

defects.title: Annexures and document quality
defects.objective: Check annexure inventory, references, chronology, separate indexing, true-copy relationship and machine-observable document quality.
defects.instruction: Use the annexure map, document outline, Index, List of Dates, petition references, typography and OCR coverage. Confirm every referenced annexure is present, labelled separately, separately indexed rather than collectively marked, and ordered consistently with the List of Dates. Check the Rule 6 true-copy declaration relationship without deciding authenticity. Check observable legibility, one-side layout and double-spacing indicators where machine evidence supports them. Treat poor OCR alone as a processing warning unless page rendering independently establishes unreadability.

subchecks.title: Referenced annexures present
subchecks.criterion: Every annexure referenced in the petition has a corresponding active filing component.
manual_review_when: Annexure labels are damaged or ambiguous

subchecks.title: Annexure chronology
subchecks.criterion: Annexures are ordered consistently with the List of Dates and related petition references.
manual_review_when: An annexure has no reliable date

subchecks.title: Separate annexure indexing
subchecks.criterion: Annexures are individually labelled and indexed rather than collectively marked.
manual_review_when: Index rows are incomplete

subchecks.title: True-copy relationship
subchecks.criterion: The filing contains the Form 28 Rule 6 declaration connecting annexures to the record below.
manual_review_when: Jubeex cannot determine whether a copy formed part of the record below

subchecks.title: Legibility and layout
subchecks.criterion: Petition, applications and accompanying documents are visibly legible and machine-observable layout indicators do not contradict double spacing and one-side presentation.
manual_review_when: OCR and rendered-page quality disagree or physical presentation cannot be inferred

decision_policy.compliant: Every annexure reference resolves, ordering/index checks pass and quality coverage is complete.
decision_policy.defect_found: Complete evidence proves an annexure is missing, misordered or not separately indexed.
decision_policy.not_applicable: No annexures exist and the filing contains no annexure references.
decision_policy.not_determined: Annexure, Index, chronology or page-quality coverage is incomplete.
decision_policy.needs_review: True-copy provenance or observable quality cannot be conclusively assessed.

defects.title: Advocate's Checklist presence
defects.objective: Verify that the Advocate's Checklist is filed in the prescribed format with all requirements marked as YES, NO, or N.A., and includes the AOR declaration.
defects.instruction: Search the front of the case file (before the Cover Page and Office Report on Limitation) for the Advocate's Checklist. Confirm that it follows the prescribed numbered format with YES/NO/N.A. indicators, and concludes with the AOR's declaration.

subchecks.title: Advocate's Checklist format
subchecks.criterion: The Advocate's Checklist is present in the prescribed format.
manual_review_when: Checklist format significantly deviates from prescribed layout

decision_policy.compliant: The Advocate's Checklist is present and matches the prescribed format.
decision_policy.defect_found: The Advocate's Checklist is missing or not in the prescribed format.
decision_policy.not_applicable: Never applies because the checklist is mandatory.
